note: Beta 1 adds executable fixture-repository evaluation, reviewed baselines, mutation checks, optional live Codex runs, and cross-platform CI. Deterministic reference results do not constitute live-model certification.

executable_evaluation.limitation: Reference traces certify harness and package contracts, not live-model quality.

skill_evaluation.limitation: deterministic metadata proxy; not a live Codex trace

role_evaluation.limitation: deterministic metadata proxy and registry contract test; not a live Codex trace

orchestration_evaluation.limitation: hook events and structured results are simulated; live Codex subagent threads require separate certification
